description.value: Cosmos Pizza & Pasta is a family-run Italian restaurant that has been serving fresh pizzas and pastas in Victoria since 2007, located inside The Burnside Plaza on Tillicum Road near Tillicum Mall. With a consistent recipe and emphasis on fresh ingredients, it's a well-established neighbourhood spot for a sit-down or pick-up meal. A touring cyclist would find it a convenient dinner stop on the western side of Victoria.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: ground_slots (2 spaces, covered) at 11m; ground_slots (2 spaces, covered) at 20m; informal (covered) at 30m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business is a real, active family-run Italian restaurant operating since 2007 in Victoria's Burnside Plaza. OSM address and primary phone number are corroborated by the website; the website also lists a second phone number (250-386-1838) absent from OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null; takeout is confirmed by the website's explicit mention of a pick-up discount.
